purpose: Explicit gates that must all be satisfied before any real 2,210-image production generation begins. This file records the gate definitions and their status as of this checkpoint; it does not itself authorize generation.

gates.name: d4_live_style_confirmed
gates.description: D4's exact rendering language is the live production global_style_v1.json prompt.
gates.evidence: global_style_v1.json's prompt field was verified byte-identical to D4's calibration block when promoted (HANDOFF_20260924_CARD_ART_STYLE_D4_DURABILITY_12_RESULTS.md), and has not been modified since. D4 visual-style research is closed per this checkpoint's instructions.

gates.name: semantic_catalog_count_verified
gates.description: The rights-first eligible catalog reports exactly 2,210 baseline-art-eligible interests.
gates.evidence: buildCatalogRecipeBridge().eligible.length === 2210, re-verified this checkpoint. productionQueue.js fails closed (throws) if this count ever changes unexpectedly.

gates.name: diversity_effects_assignments_deterministic
gates.description: Diversity and effects-intensity assignments are reproducible, not random.
gates.evidence: validateProductionArchitecture.js's determinism check rebuilds the full queue twice in-process and asserts byte-identical diversity_profile/effects_profile/batch_number/prompt_sha256 for all 2,210 rows.

gates.name: known_localized_recipe_fixes_implemented
gates.description: books.reading, wellness.cold_plunge, sports.skateboarding, and wellness.tai_chi fixes are implemented in hobby_overrides_v1.json.
gates.evidence: All four overrides present and compiled successfully in this checkpoint's regression check (0 errors across all 2,210 rows).

gates.name: batch_plan_validated
gates.description: The 2,210 (2,208 auto-production) queue is partitioned into ~120-image batches with no duplicate or missing assignments.
gates.evidence: validateProductionArchitecture.js confirms every non-quarantined id has exactly one batch assignment, batch sizes are <= 120, and the union of all batch id lists equals the auto-production set with no duplicates.

gates.name: resume_safe_logic_validated
gates.description: A restart never regenerates an already-succeeded image and only submits remaining pending/retry ids.
gates.evidence: validateProductionArchitecture.js's resume-safety check mocks a manifest with some succeeded/failed/pending entries and asserts planSubmission() excludes every succeeded id and includes only pending/retry/unresolved ids.

gates.name: failure_only_retry_validated
gates.description: Retry planning only ever includes failed_transient/retry_pending ids, never successful ids, and content-policy failures do not auto-retry.
gates.evidence: validateProductionArchitecture.js's retry check mocks failed_transient, failed_content, and succeeded entries in the same batch and asserts the retry plan contains only the failed_transient id.

gates.name: cost_estimator_validated
gates.description: Cost accounting distinguishes planned vs successful vs billed vs failed/retried, and never assumes failures are billed without evidence.
gates.evidence: productionCostReport.js only counts actual_cost_usd when a manifest record explicitly carries it from real billing metadata; validateProductionArchitecture.js exercises this against mocked mixed-outcome data.

gates.name: qa_sampling_plan_documented
gates.description: A layered QA plan (static checks, representative sampling, high-risk targeted review, cluster-defect escalation) is written down before any real generation.

gates.name: quarantine_enforcement_validated
gates.description: sports.american_football and technology.robotics cannot receive a batch assignment or be auto-submitted.
gates.evidence: Both ids are present in the 2,210 eligible set (rights-wise fine) but productionQueue.js gives them batch_number=null, status=quarantined_excluded, and planSubmission() in productionManifest.js explicitly skips any entry with quarantined=true regardless of manifest state.

gates.name: no_github_actions_dependency
gates.description: The production pipeline does not require or trigger GitHub Actions.
gates.evidence: All queue-building, batch-planning, cost, and QA-plan work in this checkpoint is local Node script execution only; no workflow files were added, modified, or triggered.

gates.name: no_vercel_dependency
gates.description: The production pipeline does not require or trigger Vercel.
gates.evidence: No deployment, preview, or Vercel-related action was taken or is required by any script added this checkpoint.

gates.name: explicit_user_authorization_to_start_production_generation
gates.description: A new, explicit user instruction to begin submitting real production batches.
gates.status: NOT satisfied - this is the blocking gate
gates.evidence: Not requested in this checkpoint's task; this checkpoint explicitly forbids starting production generation. No batch has been submitted.

overall_status: 12 of 13 gates satisfied. Gate 13 (explicit user authorization) is the sole remaining blocker. The architecture is otherwise READY.
critical_rule: Do not submit any production batch without a new, explicit user instruction to start production generation.
